text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after marking a milestone in our 
three years together in the Twinkle Series 
with Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the voucher won at the raffle, I 
came to the hot springs with Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I will leave everything in your hands 
today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You must have done a lot of preparation, 
haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As my Trainer... you will let me rest 
plenty, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To give Gentildonna—who is stoic yet great 
at relaxing—a thorough rest... At the 
time, I had set myself such a difficult 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder just how you plan on refreshing 
me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I shall assess you thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At that moment, it hit me. Testing each 
other, showing off our power... This is 
just like how we always do things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the goal is to refresh oneself, isn't 
relaxing your shoulders the first 
prerequisite? If so—
choice_data_list: Should we go to the hot springs first?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: 先に温泉に行っちゃおうか
choice_data_list_en: Should we go to the hot springs first?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fresh out of the bath, Gentildonna's usual 
intimidating aura feels reduced by a 
third... no, maybe even by half... or so 
it seems.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderfully soothing bath.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Normally, the only ryokan we stay at are 
ones where we've been invited by 
associates of our family, so...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Opportunities to visit unfamiliar places 
are quite precious, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—If I let the people involved know, maybe 
they'll owe me one.
choice_data_list: (...I ended up coming back for a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: And? What is your next strategy?
choice_data_list: （……ちょっと戻ってきてしまった）

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh, it's gotten completely dark.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Options seem limited, though. What are you 
going to do for me from here?
choice_data_list:
…Can you relax your shoulders just a 
little more?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Are you trying to catch me off 
guard?
choice_data_list_en: ...Can you relax your shoulders a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And so, watching for an opening in my 
guard... Are you aiming to strike me down 
as well, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I have never once thought 
about taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is something other than me. Or 
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to make me submit by using 
brute force?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: With those slender arms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A stinging, menacing aura is directed at 
me— Just as I try to react on instinct... 
I notice something different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna is definitely projecting her 
aura this way— though it's merely in 
jest...
choice_data_list: ...Ah, I think I can do it now.
...Yeah, feels like we could do it now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list_en: ...Yeah, feels like I could do it now.
...Yeah, feels like we can do it now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bring my hands together in front of 
Gentildonna's face— and give a light, 
sharp clap.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: Haha, you let your guard down
Fufu, you let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Because I never imagined you'd do 
something so outrageous.
choice_data_list_en: Haha, you let your guard down.
Hehe, you let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, there is a chance I might have 
snapped it in half on reflex.
choice_data_list: いつもなら、俺の手は無事じゃない
いつもなら、私の手は無事じゃない
choice_data_list_en: Normally, my hand wouldn't be in one piece.
Normally, my hand wouldn't be in one piece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the moment she arrived today, 
Gentildonna has been more relaxed than 
usual.
choice_data_list: でも、そうならなかった

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was because I had promised to "let her 
rest plenty"... Believing in those words, 
she was spending this very moment with me.
choice_data_list: You've shown the power of your trust.

You proved the power of your trust, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "So that softens... my power."
choice_data_list: 君の信頼という力を示したわけだ
貴方の信頼という力を示したわけだね
choice_data_list_en: So you demonstrated the power of your trust.
So you've demonstrated the power of trust, then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's still too naive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment—Gentildonna gently 
brought her lips to my ear...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —I win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Gentildonna...
